title: "Maker Movement" Approach to Computing; Human-AI Fiction Co-Writing
description: Explores the dynamic process of co-writing fiction with artificial intelligence, utilizing Sudowrite as the primary tool. Students will learn how to blend their creativity with AI-generated content, creating stories that harness the strengths of both human and machine imagination. Through a series of practical exercises and guided projects, students will experiment with AI-assisted writing prompts, plot development, character creation, and narrative structures, refining their work through iterative collaboration. By the end of the course, students will have developed a unique co-written narrative, while also gaining insights into the ethical and creative implications of AI in storytelling.
